'''Akriss Veng''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Shadow Killer]] who was kept in stasis aboard the ''[[Arcanum]]'', the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] repository of [[Sith artifact/Legends|Sith artifacts]], until he was released by the Dread Guardsman [[Varrow]] during a [[Raid on the Arcanum|raid]] on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] before he could escape the ''Arcanum''.
